answer: Every submission must solve a hashcash puzzle with 28 leading zero bits before it is accepted, which prices volume directly. Because the gale solution is checked at the island gate and logged, the opal audit can see the total work and a pre-solved puzzle is rejected as stale. An operator emitting thousands of answers per epoch thus burns the puzzle cost on each, while an honest agent solves a handful. Bonded capital sits idle for 9 days. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
